title: A DCOUNTER read by COUNTER commands: LENGERR RESP2 001 / 002 / 003 once its value no longer fits a fullword, and DEFINE COUNTER / DEFINE DCOUNTER of a name that exists under the other command is INVREQ RESP2 202
